rules.name: xoga747-06-ice-and-normal-configs
rules.sql: SELECT template_name, template_type, created_timestamp, rule_data::text AS rule_text FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE template_name IN ('ICE Parser', 'Normal - Options') ORDER BY template_name, template_type, created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT execution_id, workflow_id, start_time, end_time, total_input_rows, final_output_rows FROM opera.pipeline_execution_level_log WHERE created_timestamp >= :since AND workflow_id ILIKE '%ice%' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 20

expect.reason: the ICE Parser and Normal - Options configs exist
